annotations.title: Decode a JWT and flag risks

description: Decodes a JWT locally and returns its header, claims (field values whose names look like secrets are masked), time-claim status (exp, nbf, iat) and risk notes such as alg none, HMAC algorithms that cannot be verified offline, missing exp, and jku/jwk/x5u key-injection headers. DECODING IS NOT VERIFICATION: this tool has no key, never checks the signature and cannot tell you the token is genuine. Prefer token_env (the NAME of an environment variable) so the raw token does not pass through the model; a token passed as `token` is already in the context. The claims returned are in the model context either way.

token.description: The JWT itself. Passing it here puts it in the model context; use token_env when possible.

token_env.description: NAME of an environment variable that holds the JWT. Preferred: the raw token then never passes through the model.
